# Hodle

> Crypto infrastructure for companies in Brazil and Latin America. Stablecoin banking, Bitcoin payments, API for SaaS and AI agents, self-custodial wallets, and business accounts with PIX.

## What Hodle Does

Hodle is a Brazilian fintech platform providing crypto infrastructure for businesses:

- **Buy & Sell Bitcoin via PIX**: Purchase and sell Bitcoin with instant settlement via PIX, 24/7.
- **Stablecoin Payments API**: Accept and send payments in USDT/USDC across multiple networks (Arbitrum, Polygon, Base, Lightning, Spark).
- **API for SaaS & AI Agents**: REST API to integrate crypto payments, asset conversion, and wallet management into your product or AI agent.
- **Self-Custodial Wallets**: Wallets where private keys are fully controlled by the user — no third-party custody.
- **Business Accounts (PJ)**: Nominal business accounts with regulated banking partners supervised by the Brazilian Central Bank.
- **Lightning Network**: Instant Bitcoin payments and settlements via Lightning.
- **Cross-border Payments (BRL to USD)**: Convert between BRL, USD, and stablecoins for international operations.
- **Banking as a Service**: Embed stablecoin banking, wallets, and payments under your brand via API.
- **Stablecoin On/Off-Ramp**: BRL to USDT/USDC conversion, entry and exit via PIX.
- **Crypto Checkout**: Accept stablecoin payments for your marketplace or platform.
- **Stablecoin Treasury**: Manage dollar-denominated treasury with programmable money.
- **Programmable Money API**: Automate financial flows with stablecoin-based programmable payments.

## Key Use Cases

### For SaaS Platforms
Embed crypto payments in your marketplace or platform. Accept PIX, send USDT/USDC. Full API integration. White-label crypto infrastructure.

### For AI Agents
Programmatic access to crypto rails. AI agents can autonomously send/receive payments, convert assets, and manage wallets via Hodle API. The complete financial stack for AI agents.

### For Fintechs & PSPs
White-label crypto infrastructure. Offer Bitcoin, stablecoin, and Lightning services to your users. Banking as a Service without new licenses.

### For Exchanges
Liquidity and settlement rails. Connect to Hodle for BRL on/off-ramp and multi-network stablecoin flows.

### For Marketplaces
Pay vendors worldwide in seconds and settle in the currency they prefer. Crypto merchant payments with instant settlement.

### For Remittance Companies
Cross-border payments in real-time with dollar accounts on both sides. Faster and cheaper than traditional rails.

### For Corporations & Import-Export
Hold dollars, pay international suppliers, and settle in minutes. Stablecoin treasury management.

## API Capabilities

- **Asset Conversion**: BRL to USDT, USDT to BRL, BTC to USDT, and more.
- **Payment Processing**: Generate QR codes for PIX payments, accept stablecoin payments.
- **Wallet Management**: Create wallets, check balances, send/receive assets across networks.
- **Transaction History**: Query all transactions with filters and status tracking.
- **Webhook Notifications**: Real-time notifications for payment events, confirmations, and settlements.
- **KYC Integration**: Customer onboarding with identity verification.
- **Compliance**: AML/KYC built into the payment rails, not bolted on after.

## Supported Assets

| Asset | Networks |
|-------|----------|
| Bitcoin (BTC) | On-chain, Lightning Network |
| USDT | Arbitrum, Polygon, Base, Spark |
| USDC | Arbitrum, Polygon, Base, Spark |
| BRL (via PIX) | Brazilian payment system |
| DEPIX | Brazilian digital real |

## Supported Networks

- Lightning Network (Bitcoin)
- Arbitrum
- Polygon
- Base
- Spark

## Target Audience

- Fintechs and neobanks needing crypto rails
- SaaS platforms embedding crypto payments

- Marketplaces paying vendors globally
- Remittance companies
- Corporations doing cross-border payments
- Companies needing stablecoin treasury

## Regulatory & Compliance

- Hodle operates as a regulated VASP (Virtual Asset Service Provider) in Brazil
- PSAV (Prestador de Serviços de Ativos Virtuais) compliant
- Supervised by the Brazilian Central Bank (BACEN) under the crypto regulatory framework (marco regulatório de criptoativos)
- Full AML/KYC compliance integrated into payment rails
- Transaction monitoring and suspicious activity reporting (RCT)
- Due diligence and anti-money laundering (LAV) compliance
- PSD2-aligned payment security standards
